note: Attacker-controlled input bytes are passed to the OpenStep plist parser, which constructs a plist node tree from the input.

code: Parse OpenStep plist text into a plist_t node tree.
note: The parser builds a tree of plist nodes. Malformed or specially crafted OpenStep plist content can cause nodes to be linked in a way that creates dangling references or cycles.

code: Recursively parse OpenStep plist elements and attach child nodes to parent structures.
note: During recursive parsing, child nodes are attached to parent containers. A crafted input can cause a node to be freed or reallocated while still referenced by a parent, leaving a dangling pointer.

code: Parse array elements and append them to the array node's child list.
note: Array elements are appended to the node list. If parsing fails partway through, cleanup may free child nodes while the parent still holds references to them.

code: Parse dictionary key-value pairs and attach them to the dictionary node.
note: Dictionary entries are attached to the node tree. A malformed dictionary can cause a key or value node to be freed during error handling while the dictionary still references it.

code: Parse a quoted string and create a plist string node.
note: String parsing may fail and free the partially constructed node, but the caller may still hold a pointer to it, creating a use-after-free condition.

code: Parse base64-encoded data and create a plist data node.
note: Base64 decoding can fail, causing the node to be freed while the parent still references it.

code: Parse a date value and create a plist date node.
note: Date parsing can fail and free the node while the caller retains a dangling reference.

code: Parse a real number and create a plist real node.
note: Number parsing can fail and free the node while the caller retains a dangling reference.

code: Parse an integer and create a plist integer node.
note: Integer parsing can fail and free the node while the caller retains a dangling reference.

code: Parse a boolean value and create a plist boolean node.
note: Boolean parsing can fail and free the node while the caller retains a dangling reference.

code: Parse a UID value and create a plist UID node.
note: UID parsing can fail and free the node while the caller retains a dangling reference.

code: Parse a null value and create a plist null node.
note: Null parsing can fail and free the node while the caller retains a dangling reference.

note: Comment skipping can affect parser state and cause incorrect node attachment or premature cleanup.

code: Skip whitespace in the OpenStep plist input.
note: Whitespace handling affects token boundaries and can cause the parser to misinterpret structure, leading to dangling node references.

code: Free partially constructed nodes during error handling.
note: Error cleanup frees nodes that may still be referenced by parent containers, creating use-after-free conditions.

code: Return the parsed root node to the caller.
note: The returned root node may contain dangling child pointers if error cleanup freed them prematurely.
Freeing the root node recursively frees all children. If a child was already freed during parsing error cleanup, this triggers a heap-use-after-free read when traversing the node tree.

code: Recursively free plist node and its children.
note: The recursive free reads the node's child pointers. A dangling pointer to a freed child causes a heap-use-after-free READ 8 at this location, matching the crash state.
